individuals_and_professionals.role_title: Tribal Chief (Sardar) of the Gadehi Baloch Tribe
individuals_and_professionals.biography: Respected Chief (Sardar) of the Gadehi Baloch community, leading tribal unity, traditional jirga reconciliation, and educational advancement across Sindh.
Web developer, educator, and founder of the Gadehi Baloch Global Heritage digital archive, preserving tribal history and uniting community professionals.
